svg.text: One compare per register: the lane's d0 against the register's constant COL[e]
Row 13 is held by two lanes, 16 registers each
d0 = row − delta − 4h = 13 − 0 − 0 = 13: keeps every e with COL[e] ≤ 13
d0 = row − delta − 4h = 13 − 0 − 4 = 9: keeps every e with COL[e] ≤ 9
COL[e]: the column register e holds when h = 0 (h = 1 adds 4)
Per register: v_cmp d0 ≥ COL[e], then v_cndmask with −inf.
d0 = row − delta − 4h is one value per lane and tile; COL[e] is an inline constant. Nothing is computed per element
or kept live through the loop -- unlike the generic gl.where(row − col ≥ delta), whose 32 row − col values LLVM
hoists out of the loop, where they spill.
